statement: Persistent power shortages are cited as prompting NVIDIA to lower product power specifications, with the mainstream Rubin Ultra SKU at 1,800W Max-Q.
why: If power availability, not silicon, is what limits deployment, then accelerator design is being pulled toward efficiency and the ceiling on installed compute is set outside the chip supply chain.

impact.mechanism: Scarce datacenter power forces lower per-accelerator power envelopes, constraining how much compute can be installed and shifting product design toward performance per watt.

evidence.excerpt: power shortages will persist, prompting NVIDIA to lower product power specifications

confidence.basis: Secondary supply-chain reporting with no official confirmation; qualitative claim only.
